paper_title: MARBLE A Hard Benchmark for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning and Planning
caption: Performance of GPT-o4-mini on with binary or detailed feedback from solution validator. On , the performance will remain 0%.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the performance of GPT-4-mini with binary or detailed feedback from a solution validator, comparing accuracy across rounds of conversation. The x-axis, labeled "Round of Conversation", has a linear scale with values ranging from 1 to 5, and tick labels at every integer interval. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", also has a linear scale with values from 10 to 25, and tick labels at every 5% interval. The plot contains two lines: one in orange, representing binary feedback, starts at approximately 11% accuracy at Round 1 and increases to around 23% at Round 5, showing a steady trend with no notable peaks or declines; the other in blue, representing detailed feedback, starts at about 11% accuracy at Round 1 and increases to approximately 28% at Round 5, also showing a steady trend.
